Hi Bethany — following up with the technical details you asked for.

Audit period for the attached Type II report:
- Covered period: 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30
- Date of attestation issuance: 2025-08-12

Bridge letter summary (attached):
- Bridge letter effective: 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-15
- Purpose: To certify that there were no material control changes or exceptions impacting the SOC 2 coverage during the bridge window. The bridge is signed by our VP of Security and includes the same control categories as the Type II report (Security, Availability, Confidentiality).
- Limitations: Bridge is not a substitute for a full Type II report; it is a management letter confirming continuity. It does not include new auditor testing.

On auditor access: We will provide contact details for our CPA firm (attestation issuer) to your auditors upon request. We require a standard NDA/ROE for auditor access to any non-public evidence; we can pre-share the NDA template if helpful.

Attachments included here: SOC2_Bridge_Letter_202607.pdf (signed bridge by VP Security)

If FinServe requires the bridge to be extended further (e.g., to cover through Aug 2026), we can escalate to our security & audit partners and let you know feasibility, but that will likely require a short timeline extension for additional validation.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call to walk through the documents.

— Monica Patel
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
